title: Espresso Cashew Brownies
changes_from_base: Instant espresso melted into the chocolate, with toasted cashews folded through and scattered on top.
summary: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies with espresso melted into the batter and toasted cashews through and on top.
equipment: 20 cm square metal baking tin, lined with baking paper
heatproof bowl and small pan (or a microwave)

ingredients.note: 100 g chopped for the batter, 50 g halved for the top

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan), spread the cashews on a tray and toast 6-8 min until pale gold, then cool. Chop 100 g and halve the rest.

steps.title: Melt
steps.text: Melt the butter, chocolate and espresso powder together gently, stir until smooth and let it stand 5 min.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Whisk in both sugars and the salt, add the eggs one by one, whisking hard after each, then stir in the vanilla.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Fold in the flour and the chopped cashews, scrape into the lined tin and scatter the halved cashews over the top.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 24-28 min, until the crust is set and a cocktail stick comes out with moist crumbs.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool fully in the tin before lifting out and cutting into 16 squares.

tips: Use instant espresso powder, not ground coffee; decaf works too.
Salted roasted cashews work too; skip the added salt if using them.
Let the brownies cool fully for clean cuts.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep in an airtight box at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
